senses.gloss:
गौतम गौतम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गोतम), re-
lating to Gotama (e. g. with पद-स्तोभाः, N. of a
Sāman); (अस्), m., N. of Buddha or Śākya-muni
the founder of the Buddhist religion; N. of a teacher
of ritual; N. of a grammarian; of a legislator; a patro-
nymic of Kuśri, of Aruṇa, of Uddālaka, of Śaradvat,
of Śatānanda; the father of Ekata, Dvita, and Trita
(Mahā-bh. IX. 2073); N. of the first pupil of the
last Jina; a kind of poison, one of the fixed kinds;
(ई), f. a patronymic of Kṛpī and other women; an
epithet of Durgā; N. of a Rākṣasī or female gob-
lin; N. of a river, = गोमती; a kind of yellow pig-
ment or dye, = गो-रोचना; turmeric; (अम्), n., N.
of a Sāman; fat; [cf. मेदस्, and भारद्वाज,
‘bone.’]
—गौतम-सम्भवा, f. an epithet of
the river Godāvarī.
—गौतम-सरस्, अस्, n., N. of
a lake.
—गौतम-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a Jaina
teacher; [cf. गोतम-स्वामिन्.]
गौतमक, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Nāgas.

गौतमीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to Gautama,
coming from him &c.

गौतमस गौतमस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गो-तमस्?),
epithet of two verses of the Sāma-veda.
